Description: Benchmark motivational speakers' audiences, messaging, content formats, websites, funnels, social, email, ads, partnerships, course pricing.
Deliverable: Research report or slide deck plus comparison chart and recommendations
AI Completion Notes: High: core work is research, compare, synthesize, recommend.
Entry Barrier Notes: Low-medium: domain familiarity useful but no hard credential.

Job Title: Market Researcher Needed to Compile ROI & Performance Stats by Marketing Channel
Description: Gather credible ROI/performance stats by marketing channel with citations, nonprofit preferred.
Deliverable: Spreadsheet with stats, ROI, citations; optional summary
AI Completion Notes: High if public sources suffice; reduced if paid databases are required.
Entry Barrier Notes: Medium: source credibility and fast timeline.

Description: Research 20 top Australian social accounts in buyer's niche plus buyer-provided accounts.
Deliverable: Competitor social account research with comparison findings
Primary Input Type: Public social media accounts; client-provided examples
AI Completion Notes: High: public social review and pattern extraction.

Job Title: Pitch Deck Creation and Market Research for Clothing Brand
Description: Conduct fashion market research on social/ecommerce platforms with competitive analysis, then create pitch deck.
Deliverable: Pitch deck with market research and competitive insights
Primary Input Type: Public social/ecommerce data; client brand materials
Evidence Depth: Needs fact collection plus narrative synthesis
AI Completion Notes: Medium-high: AI helps research/narrative; deck quality needs human judgment.

Job Title: Market Research Specialist for Startup Goals
Description: Validate Home & Garden startup assumptions: market size, growth, scenarios, competitor benchmarking, gaps, target customers.
Primary Input Type: Public market/competitor data; client pitch deck/model
AI Completion Notes: Medium-high: AI helps research and scenarios; judgment remains central.

Job Title: Investigador de Productos para Dropshipping - Guatemala/Honduras
Description: Evaluate provided product lists using demand, pricing, competitor presence, profitability, and market fit.
Deliverable: Concise report with best products plus pricing and competitive insights
Primary Input Type: Client product lists; public ecommerce/market data
AI Completion Notes: Medium-high: AI helps compare/rank; regional context matters.

Job Title: AI-Driven Branding and UX Audit Consultant
Description: One-time AI recommendations, branding review, and UX/brand audit with actionable recommendations.
Primary Input Type: Client site/brand materials; public competitor/UX references
Evidence Depth: Needs heuristic review and evidence-backed recommendations
AI Completion Notes: High: AI can assist audit checklist and synthesis; human judgment needed for brand/UX recommendations.
Entry Barrier Notes: Medium: expert label, but no hard tool/local barrier visible.

Job Title: Competitive Ad & Website Researcher - find competitors' ads, products & sites and native ads
Description: Find competitor websites, product listings, native ads, placements, archived/duplicate sites.
Deliverable: Spreadsheet with URLs, screenshots/ad links, source notes; short summary
AI Completion Notes: High for OSINT, but output is closer to evidence collection than judgment.
Exclusion Reason: Too close to low-priced information gathering; weak transaction economics.

Deliverable: Excel scoring matrix, maps/charts/scorecards, executive summary
AI Completion Notes: Medium: AI helps narrative, not core data access.
Entry Barrier Notes: High: US-only and specialized paid tools.
Exclusion Reason: Depends on local identity and specialized paid location data.

Job Title: Market Research & Feasibility Study for Organic Dairy Farm
Description: Validate organic dairy opportunity with primary customer research, competitor mapping, TAM/SAM/SOM, distribution, pricing, risk.
Deliverable: 30-40 page report, survey data, competitor matrix, Go/No-Go, presentation
Primary Input Type: Primary survey data; market sizing; logistics inputs
Evidence Depth: Primary survey and financial/logistics validation required
AI Completion Notes: Medium: AI helps reporting, but primary research dominates.
Exclusion Reason: Primary research and feasibility complexity exceed low-asset boundary.

Evidence Depth: Defensible methodology and HR standards required
AI Completion Notes: Medium: AI helps structure; accuracy/risk requires expertise.

Job Title: B2B Marketing Strategist with Microsoft Partner Ecosystem Expertise
Description: Develop GTM strategy/playbooks based on ICP, pain points, competitive landscape, Microsoft partner ecosystem.
Primary Input Type: Client context; public competitor/ICP research; ecosystem knowledge
AI Completion Notes: Medium: AI helps synthesis; expertise is central.

Job Title: SEO Expert Needed to Optimize 80 Landing Pages for Multilingual DMS Website
Description: Optimize 80 multilingual SaaS landing pages with SEO audit, keyword research, on-page work, competitor benchmark, tracking setup.
Deliverable: SEO audit, 80 landing-page optimizations, keyword strategy, roadmap
Primary Input Type: SEO tools, site access, multilingual keyword data
AI Completion Notes: Medium: AI helps analysis, but task is SEO execution.

Job Title: Google Ads Specialist for Ladies' Salon in Abu Dhabi
Description: Set up and manage Google Ads campaigns, keyword research, conversion tracking, optimization, weekly reports.
Primary Input Type: Google Ads account, local keyword data, tracking stack
AI Completion Notes: Low-medium: AI can help copy/research; execution is ad management.
Entry Barrier Notes: High: Google Ads execution and UAE market/language preference.

Job Title: Expert Deal Sourcer Wanted for Private Equity Off-Market Opportunities
Description: Source off-market acquisition opportunities, pre-qualify with PE metrics, outreach owners, maintain pipeline.
Deliverable: Target list, deal memos, owner outreach results, weekly pipeline/report
Primary Input Type: Private deal sourcing, owner outreach, financial estimates
Evidence Depth: Requires owner contact and deal validation
AI Completion Notes: Low-medium: AI can research, but deal sourcing/outreach is human/network-heavy.
Entry Barrier Notes: Very high: PE/M&A sourcing experience and outreach.
Exclusion Reason: Deal sourcing/outreach and M&A expertise, not low-asset public-source research.

Job Title: Influencer Marketing Outreach for Fashion Brand
Description: Identify influencers, develop outreach strategy, manage relationships/campaigns, report performance, monitor trends.
Deliverable: Influencer outreach program and campaign reporting
Primary Input Type: Public social data plus influencer relationships/outreach
Evidence Depth: Requires campaign execution and relationship management
AI Completion Notes: Medium: AI helps research, but execution dominates.
Exclusion Reason: Ongoing outreach/execution, not standalone comparative research.

Job Title: Build Excel Tool to Compare Weekly Fruit & Vegetable Orders Across 5 Vendors (Aruba)
Description: Build Excel tool comparing vendor prices against consumption to identify best purchasing options.
